Glance 2026.07.24.1 improves Office preview reliability and input handling.

## Highlights

- Prepare Office previews in the background and reuse completed PDF results.
- Release Office source file handles promptly during preview preparation.
- Preserve Space input while renaming files or typing in Explorer text fields.
- Prevent duplicate conversion work for concurrent requests of the same Office file.
